definition: to put things one on top of another
description: A village fair on a grey day, under a marquee with bunting. A young man in a white chef's jacket and striped apron stands on a stepladder and pours a thick stream of cream from a big metal pot into a giant glass bowl, adding the top layer to a huge trifle. Through the glass the layers of sponge, fruit, jelly, custard and berries are stacked one above another. He then lifts the empty pot away and smiles. A crowd behind a rope watches and claps, a woman covers her face and a man steadies the ladder.
